result:
Round 184 is planned and dispatched as **CONTINUE**. It is the last item of the VISUAL-A stage: a test-only cleanup that the user approved on 2026-10-25 (ROOT-RECON-GRID-HARNESS). I didn't touch any app source; `git status` is clean and the frozen file list still checks OK. The advisor was available and I consulted it before writing and again at the end.

**Round 183 result.** C passed it with real browser checks, 0 bugs. Root published it as `423fbc4`.
- M4 (the cookie banner no longer covers the Studio) is now **მზადაა**. Saba can still veto the "hide, don't move" rulings (R44/R45).
- The only blocked check is the fake-login 403 test, because the backend doesn't run in the cloud.
- Four small pre-existing cookie-banner issues went to the deferred Low list, which now has 260 entries.
- The duplicated `/studio` route check in `root.tsx` and `CookieConsent.tsx` is recorded as an architecture signal only. Both reviewers said to keep it until `root.tsx` can be edited.

**Why round 184 isn't the regression round.** The last regression was 2026-10-24, so it isn't due until 2026-10-27. Round 183's plan assumed regression would come first. Because I'm planning on 2026-10-26, the order flips: the cleanup is round 184 and regression is expected to be round 185 (covering M1, M3 and M4). After that comes STORE-0, the mock backend.

**Round 184 task:**
- **Change:** the three grid UI test suites each carry the same 79-line block of fake audio classes. I confirmed the copies are byte-identical. A moves that block into one new helper, `createWorkspaceTestEnvironment`, in `app/lib/arrangement/__tests__/helpers/workspace-test-environment.ts`. Each call gives a suite its own fake clock and classes. In each suite only two lines change: the import, and one line replacing the block. Setup, teardown and every assertion stay byte-identical.
- **Scope:** A owns 4 existing files (the 3 suites and doc 151) and 2 new files (the helper and doc 152). The other 1005 tracked files are frozen. The other 73 suites that also copy this block are left alone, since the user approved only these three.
- **Acceptance:**
  - The three suites currently pass 45 of 45 tests. After the change, the sorted list of test names must match the saved list exactly; any renamed, dropped or skipped test is a FAIL.
  - Two temporary breakages check the wiring. Renaming the helper must fail typecheck in all three suites. Freezing the fake clock is observe-only, so I didn't predict which tests turn red.
  - C still runs real browser checks, so the result counts as browser-verified: a Studio screenshot compared with round 183 (0 changed pixels), the anonymous `/studio-lab` and protected `/studio/middle-east` checks, and the network and hydration checks.
- **Ableton:** not applicable (test-only, no visible behaviour).

**Architecture checkpoint.** Since VISUAL-A ends here, I re-sent root the unanswered architecture question as one bounded request with three questions, `b-round-183-checkpoint-request.md`. It blocks nothing.

**Still remaining:** the regression round, the store redesign, the 22 approved review recommendations, the advanced gain/volume stage, the deferred Lows, the Tech Lead manual checks, the backend-only checks and the final regression. Nothing needs outside input.
